lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: He cut off her hair? In the house?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did he do that? Was she alive?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did he do with the hair?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He set it down on the counter.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What did he use to cut the hair off with?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he say why he did that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What else was done to her head?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: He made you do somethin' to her, didn't he? So he-he would feel better about not bein' the only person, right? (Brendan nods "yes") Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What did he make you do to her?
